observations.quarter: Whole isolated tyre and hollow bead framed. Same V1 dimensions and shader preserved; actual prototype tyre brand/mould still unidentified. No opposite-crown junction tongues established at this view.
observations.rear-tread: Two sinuous channels, oblique branches and central links readable. Original repetition is an estimate. Broad studio reflections do not represent measured rubber chemistry.
observations.tread-detail: Old triangular tongues on the opposite crown are removed. Corrected branch endpoints remain inside the longitudinal groove, with small rounded mouth bends/glints visible. No new critical silhouette break established in this96sample view. Local sampled error criterion is50um at four probes, not a global bound or proof of the real mould.
observations.bead-opening: Hollow inner section and estimated bead/sidewall profile readable. Deliberate macro crop accepted by actual-vertex preflight; pressure, loadedshape, rimseat and inner construction not qualified.
